items.title: Planet Heads
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Enter the space age with style! The planet heads crew are always looking sharp.

- Custom dapper suits
- 8 unique skins
- Includes Sun, Moon, Earth and many more!

items.title: Tree House Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Start your Minecraft experience with this awesome tree house base! Enjoy your luxury mansion built into a tree! This base has amazing interiors and a beautiful forest outside to explore. 

- Great for parties with friends!
- Several rooms
- Survival spawn

items.title: Skyblock Hacker
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Skyblock Hacker brings hacked gear to the classic skyblock challenge!

Explore custom islands and find overpowered tools!

items.title: Arena PvP Citadel
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description:
Own the giant citadel. This massive survival spawn is also a PvP arena! Explore all the combat zones and paths. Play single player and multiplayer to see who has the edge in battle.
Features include:
- Hundreds of non-player citizens
- High detail houses
- World balanced for early game
- Parkour challenge
- Beautiful build
- Use as your Realm spawn
- Great value
Enjoy!

items.title: Moon Base
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description:
Blast off and visit this futuristic moon base! Take a drive in the lunar rover to explore the planet, tend to the indoor farms, carry out some important science experiments or sit back and relax in the base's cafeteria. Live the future!

-Custom vehicle
-Fully furnished base
-Custom terrain

items.title: Mob Pajamas HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Suit up and get ready for an all night of movies and pillow fighting with these sweet mob onesies! Featuring six popular hostile mob outfits to choose from. Great for roleplay or having some survival fun with your friends.

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Streamer Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
It’s time to go live! Grab your friends and favourite game and stream on. Step into the life of your favourite streamer. Will you become the most watched streamer of all time?

- 8 skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Neko Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
These cute neko teens are back and better than ever! With their feline friends by their sides, these skins are super cute! With colorful modern designs and those adorable cat ears, you will certainly find the perfect skin in this pack!

+ Cute skins
+ Modern designs
+ Perfect for teens

items.title: Gamers
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Gamers! Get your gear and hop on your favorite game. Minecraft is our favorite game so pick up these awesome skins to play whatever game mode you want. With cool, colorful, and modern designs, these HD skins are truly awesome!

+ Modern skin designs
+ Perfect for teens
+ Colorful HD skins

items.title: Demons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Check out these horns! Get these spicy demon teen skins and be the coolest teen in town! Give your skin some firey flare in one of these many colorful skins!

+ Modern skin designs
+ Colorful options
+ Perfect for teens
+ 1 free skin

items.title: Mob Workers
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Combine your favorite profession with a cool mob for the ultimate experience! Whether you wish to be a mob athlete, doctor, painter, or chef - we have it all here.

- 8 mob workers, enjoying their Minecraft professions!
- Start your career in style, with the latest animal fashion!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Meraki Studios.

items.title: Anime Demon Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Grow out your horns in this Anime Demon Teens skin pack, with a selection of trendy outfits to pick from! Look good while you PVP and show who is the best protagonist among us! Make the best skin choice for you!

- 7 unique demon skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Scary Animatronics vs Pros
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Will you be a scary animatronic or a pro? Choose your style!

- Horror
- Scary
- Great for roleplay

items.title: DINOSAURS
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
DINOSAURS EVERYWHERE! Discover tons of newly added dinosaurs in a massive custom world! Tame and ride them! Breed them and hatch eggs! Learn about each dinosaur as you discover journal entries.
* 36 new dinosaurs plus babies!
* Every dinosaur has its own unique behaviors, animations, and sounds.
* Predator/prey interactions. Watch them fight!
* A gorgeous map to explore!
items.changelog:
! Dinosaurs now spawn outside of the custom terrain boundaries
! Dinosaurs can now be healed with their taming item and also heal over time.

items.title: ONE BLOCK!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Search and explore ONE BLOCK: Break the one block and watch it change into a new one block! Search different skyblocks!

items.title: Portal Tools
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Welcome to Portal Tools! This epic world gives you special tools that allow you to teleport through your survival adventure. Pass through these portals to escape an enemy or even save on travel time.

+ Craftable portal tool equipment
+ Includes secret agent base
+ Great for roleplaying, PvP, and PvE

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Prison World: Cops vs. Robbers
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Prison World: Cops vs. Robbers is here! Roleplay by yourself or on multiplayer. Break out of prison, be a prison guard, drive crop cars, or make your own roleplay adventure! Play this epic prison world how you want.

+ Made for prison or jail role-playing
+ Prison world
+ Includes prisoner NPCs
+ Includes prison guard NPCs

items.title: Secret Underground Base
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Live life as a millionaire and customize your very own mansion with a secret base that is underground. Secret Underground Base is a great survival spawn for you to stylize your very own secret base. Secret base role-play!

+ Secret base
+ Underground base
+ Perfect for secret agent role-playing
+ Customize your own secret base

Secret Underground Base by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Pirate World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Ahoy, pirates! Live life as a pirate in Pirate World! Explore the pirate cove or the sail the seas. Beware! Pirate skeletons and sharks are always close. Enjoy Pirate World with a friend or by yourself!

+ Pirate themed world
+ Multiple skeleton pirates
+ Sharks
+ Multiplayer or single player gameplay
+ Epic pirate survival
+ Includes pirate skins

By Pickaxe Studios

items.title: School World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
School World map includes massive buildings with classrooms, lockers, gym, theater, football field, baseball field and more! Take on a role as a high school student or teacher. Roleplay or play the world in normal survival.

+ School themed world 
+ Great for roleplaying
+ Includes 4 skins

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Arctic City
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Stay frosty with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! It's always cold in Arctic City, but last night was bitterly so. You arise with the dawn, an eerie feeling settling upon you. The dawn is always quiet, but never quite this silent. What stalked the night that made everyone disappear? Supply yourself because dusk is fast approaching...

items.title: Marea
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Get sophisticated with Shaliquinn's Schematics! Welcome to Marea, an art & culture center teeming with activities for you to enjoy. Interested in architecture? Look in any direction and enjoy! Are you an artsy type? Sit down and ponder what the artist was trying to say in the viewing area! More physical? Climb the rock wall! Survivalist? Make it a mega base!

items.title: Glitched Cubes
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Red Cubes, Blue Cube, and so much more! These skins are perfect for your mob adventures!

- 11 skins

items.title: Space Cubes
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Scary Cubes, Love Cube, and so much more! These skins are perfect for your mob adventures!
